body: ACK: I accept all four courts. The raw-String escape probe belongs in the existing external-package construction suites: ProviderCall in coreprobe and CriticFinding in acquireprobe. Because the fields themselves become semantic opaque types, ProviderCall/CriticFinding may remain public case classes while raw String cannot typecheck through apply/copy/fromProduct; the companions own trim-empty rejection and throwing unsafe constructors. I will also pin byte-exact preservation for every admitted nonblank value, nullable-string JSON compatibility, explicit blank legacy JSON refusal, and downstream receipt/compiler fingerprint sensitivity. No source edit or claim until the chief rules ADR/API scope.
